column1: ; The craft items generate_sitem.py writes besides those of match_sitem_shape.tsv: every item a craft plan of the
; translation makes that had no sheet (generate_core4_sheets/plan_items.py, plans()), and the crafting and harvest
; tools of the translation that had none: the refugee ones (the starting roles give itrtmw), the common ones and the
; tool maker ittool, which the tool plans need in hand. The plans domain of the sheet generator reads the first column
; to know which items will exist
; item: the translation id (translation/work/item_words_wk.txt), which is the sheet name
; shapes: from the pipeline (shape_list.txt); - for an item no character shows, whose slot is hidden (jewels, ammo)
; tags: the words generate_sitem.py reads, as in sitem_parsed.tsv: origin (fyros, matis, tryker, zorai, common, tribe,
;   kami, karavan; starter for refugee), family (melee, ranged, ammo, shield, armor, jewel, crafting tool, harvest
;   tool, mission construction), kind (the parent's words: one-handed pistol, light caster armor boots...), damage type
;   of ammo (blunt, piercing, slashing), mq and hq for the medium and high texture sets, advantage with the word of
;   its advantage, faction for the kami and karavan faction items (their glow)
; melee weapons (the staffs, the named advantage weapons, the common magic amplifier, the refugee sword, the candy cane and the kami and karavan faction weapons)
; range weapons (civilisation, common, tribe, the named advantage ones, kami and karavan)
; ammunition: one per weapon kind and damage type (b blunt, the texts' smashing; p piercing; s slashing)
; shields (common, the named advantage bucklers, the kami and karavan shields, the Armlet of Atys)
; armor (caster pieces, Erouk'an's heavy armor, refugee light pieces; the underwear plans make the palette's ic?auwp and
; crafting and harvest tools (kami and karavan, the refugee and common tools, and the tool maker)
; construction pieces of the kami and karavan constructions, crafted as mission items
